cells.gaps: No count of offices or posts entering digitally against the country's own total (13 conservatórias and 80 posts in GNB-030; 55 offices and 20 health sites in GNB-035): the one counted office, Santa Luzia, is in Bissau, and the posts in Tombali and Quinara (GNB-011, GNB-012) are uncounted, on a platform the source does not name or say is connected. GNB-007 calls Santa Luzia the first fully digital office in 2026 while GNB-011 and GNB-015 report digital registration from 2025; no dated source in the evidence other than the excluded essay says rural offices are outside the system, so rural gap is not set.
cells.note: Births are registered digitally at one named Bissau office and at health-service registration posts in three regions, not described as a pilot, which is rung 3 on a count with no total. Rung 4 needs more than half of offices on a share or a count with a denominator, and none is given.
